title: Clean Up Before Release
description: Clean up the repository before the next release without losing active bug-fix work.

tasks.label: Verify the login-fix commits are still on the renamed branch

hints: The active branch handles login validation. Rename fix-bug to fix-login-validation, then inspect its commit history to make sure the two login-fix commits are still there.
The signup work has already been merged into main. Switch to main before removing feature/old-signup, and let Git's normal safe deletion check protect you from deleting unmerged work.

intro.message: We're preparing the next release and fix-bug is getting confusing with the other bug-fix branches. This one specifically handles login validation, so rename it to fix-login-validation. Your commits are still active, so make sure the rename doesn't affect your work. After that, clean up the old signup branch — it was already merged into main.

renameBranch.message: That branch name is much clearer. Now make sure the bug-fix commits are still attached to it.

preserveWork.message: Good. The active bug-fix work is still intact. You can safely move on to the stale branch cleanup.

deleteMergedBranch.message: Nice cleanup. The merged signup branch is gone and the active bug-fix work is still safe.

success.message: Much cleaner now. The active fix is preserved and the stale branch is out of the way.

failure.message: Something is still wrong with the branch cleanup. Check which branches are active, which work is already merged, and make sure the bug-fix commits haven't been lost.
